defects.mechanism: The translation shifts the existing string by prev+1 bytes; the C memmove shifts len+1 bytes (len = length of the prepended string). When the existing string is longer than the prepended one the C keeps only its first len+1 bytes' worth (the rest is overwritten). The C behaviour is an upstream bug that the translation silently corrects; it is still a divergence from the C on a UB-clean input.
defects.note_on_crash: After buffer_trim_left (data_offset > 0) a prepend that needs no resize makes the translation's copy_within (prev+1 bytes from data_offset) run past the end of the storage Vec: panic 'dest is out of bounds' at src_buffer.rs:189. The C stays in bounds only because its memmove moves len+1 bytes. Counted as a crash, attributed to this mechanism (the patch fixes it).
defects.confirmed_by: fix-and-rerun: the patch in results/his2trans_attribution.json (provenance.patches) makes exactly these cases agree with the C

defects.mechanism: The translation replaces the C library rand() (GENANN_RANDOM() = rand()/RAND_MAX) with a private LCG (state 1, a=1664525, c=1013904223). Every initial weight differs from the C's, and srand() no longer controls them; genann_run on a freshly initialised network therefore returns different outputs.
defects.confirmed_by: fix-and-rerun: the patch in results/his2trans_attribution.json (provenance.patches) makes exactly these cases agree with the C
